skills.description: Build, edit, animate and render 3D content in Blender with Python (bpy), usually headless. Covers modeling objects and assemblies from a description or reference image, recreating a photographed scene, laying out environments from a tabletop to a landscape or city, animation (keyframes, paths, physics, camera moves), lighting, materials and still or video renders, each checked with renders. Use whenever a task involves Blender, bpy, a .blend file, 3D modeling, a procedural 3D scene, or rendering a 3D image or animation.
